# WorkBase PH

> WorkBase PH is a Philippine-based remote hiring platform that connects employers with Filipino freelancers, virtual assistants, and remote specialists. Employers pay a flat $29 to post one job — no subscription, no bidding fees, no connects, no commission — and most candidates have a video and audio introduction so employers can judge communication and fit before messaging.

Key facts: flat $29 per job post, one-time, no subscription (in-app messaging, instant video interviews, AI-matched candidates, and applicant tracking all included; optional $15 AI Candidate Audit add-on per post); freelancers apply for free and keep 100% of what they earn; employers see full applicant profiles and contact details from day one (no paywall); most candidate profiles include a video and audio intro, an internet speed test, and a work-style assessment; AI smart matching surfaces relevant candidates and most employers shortlist within 24 hours; every employer is verified before posting. Roles hired include virtual assistants, executive assistants, customer support reps, bookkeepers, social media managers, and Shopify / e-commerce specialists. Launched 2026 by Curators Marketplace, DTI & BIR registered in the Philippines. Website: https://www.workbaseph.com

## Hire by role
- [Hire a Filipino Virtual Assistant](https://www.workbaseph.com/hire/filipino-virtual-assistant.html): rates from $300/mo, admin/inbox/calendar/research/support, cost tiers, full-time vs part-time, and hiring FAQ.
- [Hire a Filipino Bookkeeper](https://www.workbaseph.com/hire/filipino-bookkeeper.html): rates from $400/mo, QuickBooks/Xero/MYOB, responsibilities, and hiring FAQ.
- [Hire a Filipino Executive Assistant](https://www.workbaseph.com/hire/filipino-executive-assistant.html): rates from $500/mo, calendar/inbox/travel management, EA vs VA, and hiring FAQ.
- [Hire a Filipino Shopify VA](https://www.workbaseph.com/hire/filipino-shopify-virtual-assistant.html): rates from $400/mo, product ops, order support, Klaviyo, apps, and hiring FAQ.
- [Hire a Filipino Customer Support Rep](https://www.workbaseph.com/hire/filipino-customer-support.html): rates from $400/mo, email/chat/voice support, BPO experience, and hiring FAQ.
- [Hire a Filipino Social Media Manager](https://www.workbaseph.com/hire/filipino-social-media-manager.html): rates from $300/mo, content/scheduling/community/paid ads, scheduler vs. strategist, and hiring FAQ.
- [Hire a Filipino Data Entry Specialist](https://www.workbaseph.com/hire/filipino-data-entry-specialist.html): rates from $250/mo, spreadsheets/CRM cleanup/PDF-to-Excel/product listing/research, accuracy tips, and hiring FAQ.
- [Hire a Filipino Graphic Designer](https://www.workbaseph.com/hire/filipino-graphic-designer.html): rates from $350/mo, branding/social/marketing/UI, Adobe/Canva/Figma, portfolios on file, and hiring FAQ.
- [Hire a Filipino Content Writer](https://www.workbaseph.com/hire/filipino-content-writer.html): rates from $350/mo, blogs/SEO articles/web copy/email, native-level English, writing samples, and hiring FAQ.
- [Hire a Filipino Appointment Setter](https://www.workbaseph.com/hire/filipino-appointment-setter.html): rates from $400/mo, cold calling/lead qualification/calendar booking/CRM updates, and hiring FAQ.
- [Hire Filipino remote specialists by role](https://www.workbaseph.com/hire/): overview hub of all roles.
- [Done-For-You Hiring](https://www.workbaseph.com/done-for-you-hiring.html): done-for-you service for founders who need to hire fast without doing it themselves — one hire or several in the same role (sales, intake, medical billing, customer support, IT support, data entry, and more). WorkBase PH's team sources candidates, records first-round interviews, checks references and runs background verification, and confirms each candidate has proper work equipment (workstation, noise-cancelling headset, etc.) so they're work-ready from day one. Employer picks from the shortlist or interviews further themselves, and makes the final call. WorkBase PH actively supports the new hire through the first 30 days, replaces them free if it doesn't work out, and handles offboarding if the employer needs to let someone go later. Pricing is one flat fee per hire, paid in two parts: an initial deposit (taken from that fee) greenlights the search once scope is confirmed after intake, with the remaining balance due once the hire is confirmed — no subscription.
- [Filipino Remote Hiring FAQ](https://www.workbaseph.com/hire/filipino-hiring-faq.html): plain answers on costs, best platforms, OnlineJobs.ph alternatives, how to screen, and how to pay.
